.]] .]] .]] Northshire Abbey is the home of the human religious order of clerics known as the Brotherhood of Northshire. It is located in Northshire Valley in the foothills of Elwynn Forest of the Kingdom of Stormwind. The closest town to Northshire Abbey is Goldshire to the southwest. Northshire Abbey is comprised of three sections: the Main Hall, Hall of Arms, and Library Wing. It holds trainers for mages, priests, warriors, monks, and paladins, as well as a couple of quest givers. The trainers for young human warlocks haunt the small graveyard to the east of the main doors. Northwatch Hold (or Northwatch Keep) is a massive Alliance fortress located between the Merchant Coast in the Southern Barrens and Dustwallow Marsh. Following years of destructive warfare, it is one of the most important Alliance bases left in Kalimdor. Northwatch's location is strategic, blocking the coastal approaches to Dustwallow from the north, forcing any Horde assault to travel south and navigate the marshes if they wanted to reach Theramore Isle before its destruction. Nowadays, Northwatch is still important as a human foothold inside Horde territory. The large naval base is known for its massive walls, gates and its various facilities, such as an archery range, stables, a mage tower

Northshire Valley is a pristine valley in Elwynn Forest in which both Northshire Abbey and the Northshire Vineyards are located. This is where the human starting area is located, though the serene valley is visited by adventurers from all over the world. Marshal Douglas McBride of the Stormwind Guard acts as the commander of Northshire Abbey's garrison and is in charge of the defense of the valley.

, with banners of the Blackrock clan in the area.]] The Northshire Vineyards are located just east of the abbey in Northshire Valley. The vineyards were originally taken over by the agents of the Defias Brotherhood and their leader, Garrick Padfoot. It was here that human players had their first encounter with the Brotherhood, fighting their minions and retrieving the stolen property of Milly Osworth. Since the Cataclysm, the vineyards are under attack by the forces of the Blackrock clan, who are burning them to the ground.
Northfold Manor was a farm on the northwestern outskirts of the Arathi Highlands. A rare spawn named Singer appears in the small house here.

The Northridge Lumber Camp (or Northridge Lumber Mill) is a lumber mill operated by the Scarlet Crusade in the northern part of the Western Plaguelands, close to Hearthglen. Both agents of the Alliance and of the Horde realize the importance of this outpost, and send adventurers out to gather termites to wreak havoc on the Scarlet Crusade's precious lumber supply. Mickey Levine's family worked at the mill. Since the Cataclysm, the Scarlet Crusade has been removed from the lumber camp by Hearthglen Recruits. Nathaniel Dumah, a human whose family ran the Northridge Lumber Mill before the Third War, has returned and reclaimed the mill for the Argent Crusade. The camp is currently under siege by

Northrock is the northenmost point in the Tanaris Desert. It is home to a large population of kodo beasts that feed upon the shrub grasses poking up in the area. Their presence brings many tallstriders and lions hoping to nab a straggler in the herd.

Novice Thaivand is a Forsaken quest giver located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Thaivand is an apprentice of Helcular the necromancer. As a member of the Forsaken, he directed members of the Horde to find Helcular's Rod and begin the process of resurrecting him. He came to the center of the town to see the arrival of Orkus and Kasha. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

The Northsea Freebooters are making up for being fewer in number by being worse criminals and murderers.

This is a quick reference of all the existing Northrend perfect uncommon gems. An uncommon Northrend gem has a chance to be perfect when cut if the jewelcrafter has learned the Gem Perfection passive trait. The stats provided by perfect uncommon gems are superior to those provided by regular uncommon gems but generally inferior to the stats provided by rare gems. There are exceptions where perfect uncommon gems provide the same stat bonuses as their rare counterparts, e.g. Perfect Lustrous Chalcedony and Lustrous Sky Sapphire both provide +6 MP5.

Northrend Inscription Research allows a scribe to discover major glyphs. It is learned at an Inscription skill of 385 for . The cooldown resets at midnight, server time. As the tool tip indicates, it is very likely, but not guaranteed, to discover new recipes. The chance to discover something (given you still have recipes to discover) seems however to be rather high. It also produces a stack of 1 to 3 random high level Scrolls or Vellums. When you have discovered everything, you will only get scrolls and vellums. Most of these recipes can be discovered at skill 385 and onward, but a few require max 430 (as of 4.2).

The Northgate Rebellion (also spelled the Northgate rebellion) was a civil war which occurred in the Kingdom of Gilneas between forces loyal to the Gilnean monarchy, and those who supported disillusioned nobleman Darius Crowley, around the time of the end of the Third War. It was named for the region in the north of Gilneas around the Greymane Wall. The conflict was primarily a result of King Genn Greymane's decisions to leave the Alliance, to isolate his kingdom from the world behind the Wall, and for abandoning his people and the refugees from Lordaeron to the undead of the Scourge. The Northgate rebels were a group of Gilnean rebels formed around the time of the end of the Third War. Led by Lord Darius Crowley, they fought the Greymane loyalists during the Northgate Rebellion, a civil war that occurred as a result of King Genn Greymane's decisions to leave the Alliance of Lordaeron, to isolate his kingdom from the world behind the Greymane Wall, and for abandoning his people and the refugees from Lordaeron to the undead Scourge. The rebellion eventually failed, with all of its leaders imprisoned for high treason, while the remaining rebels went into hiding. The not-living were undead proto-dragons created by Galakrond after he cannibalized them and absorbed their life essence, then vomited them back up. Seemingly a by-product of the mutated Galakrond, the not-living quickly attacked any living proto-dragon who adventured too close. It was noticed that proto-dragons that were bitten by them would develop a hunger that would cause them to act like Galakrond and try to devour their living companions. After Talonixa led a proto-dragon army to kill Galakrond, it was discovered that the not-living were in fact commanded by the monstrous fiend. The Norwington Equestrian and Hunt Festival is an annual festival held at Norwington Estate and Foxhollow Woods in Tiragarde Sound. It is hosted by Lord Aldrius Norwington and Lady Elena Norwington. The festival draws equestrian riders and hunters from all over Kul Tiras for their competitions, attracting nobles and the Roughneck riders, but people of all walks of life are welcome to attend. Hunting events are held nearby in Foxhollow Woods, following with the equestrian events at the estate itself. During the events of the Fourth War, the festival was in its fifteenth year. The Norwingtons are a prominent Kul Tiran noble family living in Tiragarde Sound. They are known for their horse riders and host the annual Norwington Equestrian and Hunt Festival for equestrian riders and hunters from all over Kul Tiras, attracting nobles and the Roughneck riders to their estate.
Novice Magi are projections of two night elves in Nar'anan in Nazjatar during Legacy of Nar'anan.
Northwatch Recons are humans and dwarves located at the Fields of Blood and the Great Gate in the Southern Barrens.
Northwater Hunters are hammerhead sharks located in the waters of the northern shore of Kun-Lai Summit.

Norwington Inn is a small inn on the grounds of Norwington Estate in northern Tiragarde Sound. The inn can be found just down the path from the main manor house and serves guests to the estate invited by Lord Aldrius Norwington. Attached to the inn are a blacksmith, as well as kennels for the estate's hounds.

Norukk is a tuskarr located in Iskaara in the Azure Span. After the tuskarr caravan was ambushed by the Shadepaw gnolls, Norukk and some others were taken prisoner. His wife Hanu resolved to find him and asked the adventurer to locate him inside Kargpaw's Den. He feigned death from the corrupted gnolls and was ultimately found. After reuniting with Hanu, they traveled to Iskaara.

"Nuking" (verb infinitive: to nuke) is a simple and very common technique of offense, in which the player attempts to deal the highest amount of damage he/she is capable of generating. The term derives from "nuclear bomb", effectively describing the tactic.
A nuke can mean different things, all related to the phenomenon called "nuking" (see below).

#An acronym for "Out Of Stamina", meaning the Player character is low on health (very hurt or nearly dead) or sometimes low or out of energy, if a Rogue. Generally this should be a signal to other party members to pause so the character can regain some health or energy (sit down to have some Food, usually).Not as commonly used as OOM. #An acronym for "Out Of Speed". Used when a player finds himself out of Aspect of the Pack effect radius and threatens to fall further behind the rest of the party. #An acronym for "Out Of Sight". Used when a player is not within Line of sight of a targeted mob.
Oakenscowl is a level 10 Timberling found in a cave on the southern bank of Lake Al'Ameth in Teldrassil. Denalan wants Oakenscowl's tumor.
An acronym for "Oh My God!" or "Oh My Gosh". Usually used to express amazement of some sort or another. See also ZOMG.
Noxxion is a water elemental boss in Maraudon. It is a living symbol of Maraudon's corruption, created by Lord Vyletongue.
Nurse Stonefield was a human quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.

__NOTOC__ Nyoma is a night elf cooking vendor located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. She is a friend of Sister Aquinne and wrote Dolanaar Recipe Book for her. Nyoma also received a letter from Aquinne who asks her to come to Darnassus. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

OHKO stands for one-hit knock out, simplified to one-hit kill. OHKO is sometimes referred to as "One-shotting" someone. One-shotting is rare in World of Warcraft, compared with some other games. Therefore, the term "Two-shotting" is also used at times with little loss of effect.
oRa is modularized CT_RaidAssist replacement. Developed by Haste.

The term nymph is interchangeable with dryad. However, there are unique characteristics affiliated with each term. To be specific, the term dryad refers to the forest entities that are a formal part of the "Cenarion family." Nymphs, on the other hand, are considered to be a wilder variation. Some nymphs have joined the Alliance because of their ties to the night elves.

The Noxious Glade is a secluded glade found in the Eastern Plaguelands just north of Light's Hope Chapel up a hill. The glade suffers from the blight of the Scourge and is even more tainted than the surrounding Plaguelands. The air of the glade is a thick, sickly green and the ground is a dark purple. A plague cauldron, a slaughterhouse and a few ziggurats are found within the glade, as well as several Scourge mobs. The glade is connected to Death's Breach through a tunnel named the Noxious Pass, although the area is only named in the Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.
__NOTOC__ Nurse Neela is a Forsaken first aid trainer located in Gallows' End Tavern in Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Several Deathguards refer to her as a butcher.
The Noxious Lair, also known as the Centipaar Hive, is a minor silithid hive found in southwestern Tanaris.
__NOTOC__ Oasis Snapjaws are turtles found at the Stagnant Oasis and Lushwater Oasis in the Northern Barrens.
Oakpaw is a rare furbolg found roaming throughout Greenpaw Village in Ashenvale. He's on a 10.5-16 hour respawn timer.
Noxious Plaguebats are bats found in the Eastern Plaguelands.

A null function is one which does nothing and returns nothing. In WoW, the majority of null functions are ones which are not accessible to addons but which are visible in Lua either because of how they are accessed in WoW's native code or because they are used in GlueXML. Many null functions will generate errors or access violations when called from an addon.
O'Reily is a level 5 owl owned by Narain Soothfancy at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. After the Cataclysm, Narain relocated south to Bootlegger Outpost and has seemingly abandoned O'Reily.
